insight: There's been no rain at all lately, so stormwater runoff isn't a factor right now. The model's main signals right now: high tide timing is raising risk — how long before mid-morning the last high tide fell, which sets how much the water has just washed off the upper beach; high tide level is raising risk — a high tide can mobilize bacteria held in wet sand and push the waterline toward outfalls; and no rain has fallen, so nothing is washing off the land into the surf. The last lab sample (20 MPN/100mL) is now 12 days old — beaches are sampled about weekly, so a reading this stale carries little weight, and this estimate leans on current conditions.
